key_insight: OceanCoder uses engineering verification as a training signal to improve automated ocean-engineering simulation modelling beyond syntactically correct, executable code.
engineering_relevance: Checking inputs, required analyses and output plausibility helps align generated simulation models with engineering task requirements.
method: Fine-tune Qwen3-8B on 12,000 verified examples spanning 12 engineering task categories.
Verify input constraints, completion of required analyses and engineering plausibility of outputs.
Use graded verification rewards for group relative policy optimisation (GRPO).
evidence_signal: On a benchmark covering out-of-distribution tasks and real-world engineering cases, reported Pass@1 rises from 0% for the base model to 46.77% after supervised fine-tuning and 51.43% after GRPO.
watch_item: Engineering plausibility checks do not establish full physical validity; deployment still requires independent validation and expert review.
paper_title: OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
